image_description: A dark grey/black adult common iguana resting on light-colored stone steps. The iguana is positioned diagonally across the frame, facing right. It displays a prominent dorsal crest, a large subtympanic shield, and muscular limbs with visible claws. The skin texture appears granular and scaled. The background consists of out-of-focus stone treads.
